caption:
Homework fight again tonight? Try making it smaller. 🎒

Big piles feel heavy. Short stops feel doable.
Say the plan out loud, set a timer your child can see, and end with something to look forward to.
In LearnSum, each day is a path of 5 short stops that ends at a treasure chest.
